description: This Java class 'ClientStatusChecker' provides utility methods for verifying different client status conditions within integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. It contains static methods that assert expected client status IDs and log information during status verification.

classes.name: ClientStatusChecker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for checking and verifying client statuses in tests.

methods.name: verifyClientIsActive
methods.description: Asserts that the client's status ID is 300, indicating an active client.

methods.name: verifyClientStatus
methods.description: Verifies that the provided client status matches the ID from the client response.

methods.name: verifyClientClosed
methods.description: Logs the verification of a closed client status and asserts that the status ID is 600.

methods.name: verifyClientPending
methods.description: Logs the verification of a pending client status and asserts that the status ID is 100.

methods.name: verifyClientRejected
methods.description: Logs the verification of a rejected client status and asserts that the status ID is 700.

methods.name: verifyClientActiavted
methods.description: Logs the verification of an activated client status and asserts that the status ID is 300.

methods.name: verifyClientWithdrawn
methods.description: Logs the verification of a withdrawn client status and asserts that the status ID is 800.
